svg.title: Status: libraries* 86.0%, hardware 60.5%

rect.title: R3000A CPU / IRX Modules — IRX modules compiled AOT or handled via native HLE
SIF: EE ↔ IOP RPC and DMA
CDVD: disc reader with native layout — Instant raw reading from original sectors (.disc_layout)
SPU2: audio and CRI ADX streaming — Native sound engine driven by LIBSD and ADX streaming channels
Native DualShock 2 controller — Native gamepad service supporting XInput and DualSense
Native Memory Card — Save files stored directly on host filesystem
R5900 CPU (recompiled to C++) — 12,806 functions statically recompiled to x64 C++
Native DMA controller — DMA chains go straight to GPU without bus emulation
GS: primitives and framebuffer — Native OpenGL renderer with 2x+ internal resolution
VIF1 and VU1 — Ahead-of-time microcode and fast UNPACK with DVP overlay support
GS: textures and CLUT tables — Native GPU texture store without eDRAM emulation
DVP Overlays / VU0 — Microcode overlay management via .DVP.ovlytab tables in ELF

svg.text: * Functions of the static Sony libraries linked into SLUS_211.15 (config/funcmap.csv). Hardware: weighted per component.
